text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative? AI can learn from millions of examples and produce surprising results, but it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human creativity comes from emotions, imagination, and life itself. Perhaps the best future is a partnership: artists use AI as a tool, but the ideas and meaning still come from people. Machines can copy styles, but they cannot truly understand what art means.
